app_description.message: A customizable, password-protected website blocker and redirector.

options_master_password_hint.message: Set a master password to protect these settings. After it is saved, enter it and click Unlock Options to make changes. If no master password is set, options are unprotected and Unlock Options is disabled.

options_master_password_comment.message: Enter a master password to protect your preferences

options_user_message.message: User message (shown on every blocked page — for a per-site reminder use the note instead):

options_resolve.message: Resolve the title of blocked pages (uncheck this option to prevent blocked servers from receiving any request)

options_startup.message: Perform blocking on existing pages after initialization

options_startup_current.message: Block the current matched page when a new rule is added

options_allow_access.message: Default access time for the unblocked hostname (in seconds)

options_unlock_periods.message: Unlock durations offered on the blocked page (in minutes)

options_unlock_default.message: Preselected unlock duration on the blocked page

options_block_period.message: Block password check when wrong password is entered multiple times (in minutes)

options_reverse.message: Operate on reverse mode (only matching patterns are accessible)

options_note.message: Note shown on the blocked page (optional)

options_schedule_rule_hint.message: Leave empty to apply to all sites. A rule is a regular expression that limits this entry to matching URLs.

options_schedule_empty.message: No schedule entries yet. Blocking stays active all the time.

options_schedule_times_required.message: Enter both a start and an end time.

options_schedule_invalid_range.message: The start time must be before the end time.

options_schedule_help.message: Leave the rule empty to apply an entry to all sites. A rule is a regular expression that limits the entry to matching URLs. An 'Allow all day' entry covers the entire day.

options_sup_1.message: Optionally redirect blocked requests to this HTTP(S) URL

options_sup_2.message: This is a custom message that is shown on blocked page. Could be an instruction to open this blocked page or the administrative contact

options_sup_3.message: Inject custom CSS rules into the blocked interface. You can use this section to hide different elements or change the font properties of these elements

options_sup_6.message: To block hostnames containing a word use '*://*word*/*' rule. To block the same word inside the pathname part use '*://*/*word*' rule. If you just need to close a page with a rule, use the 'close' keyword in the 'Redirect To' box. To construct a regular expression rule, prepend the rule with 'R:' keyword. For instance, 'R:ht{2}ps*://.*\.go{2}gle\.com' blocks www.google.com on both HTTP and HTTPS protocols.

options_sup_8.message: Prepare a text file containing all the blocking rules in plain text format. After importing, press the save button for the changes to take place. To disregard the imported rules, reload this page without saving.

options_sup_10.message: When importing settings, all your existing settings will be overwritten. To export minified version, use Shift key while pressing the Export button

options_sup_11.message: By providing a regular expression rule, you can limit the current schedule to the matching URLs. To have multiple schedules with different rules, fill the section for each rule and press the save button. To delete a saved rule, fill the rule part and wait for the extension to load the schedule, then delete the timing section without removing the rule itself.

options_sup_12.message: a regular expression to limit the exposure of the current schedule

options_contextmenu_pause.message: Show "Pause Blocking" context menu on browser action's context

options_contextmenu_resume.message: Show "Resume Blocking" context menu option on browser action's context

options_contextmenu_remove_temporary.message: Show "Remove All Temporary Unblocking Rules" context menu option on browser action's context

options_contextmenu_top.message: Show "(Un)Block this Page" context menu option on page context

options_contextmenu_frame.message: Show "(Un)Block this Frame" context menu option on frame context

options_contextmenu_redirect_inspector.message: Show "Track redirects in this tab" context menu option on page context

options_contextmenu_redirect_inspector_a.message: Show "Track redirects in this tab" context menu option on browser action's context

options_no_pass_on_add.message: Do not ask for the master password to block a new hostname

options_no_pass_on_unlock.message: Do not ask for the master password to temporarily unlock a blocked page

options_disable_actions_options.message: Block context menu on this page

options_disable_actions_page.message: Block context menu and paste on blocked pages

options_popup.message: Show an overview of blocked sites when clicking the toolbar icon (otherwise a click blocks or unblocks the current site)

options_contexts_both.message: Blocking applies to both Pages and Frames

options_theme.message: Select visual mode for the blocked page

options_intro.message: Changes are saved with the Save button at the bottom of the page.

options_intro_rules.message: If you're new, block new websites by visiting the page and clicking the action button (it's in the extensions menu after installation). No need to manually make new rules.

options_sch_helper_1.message: Generate unblocking periods for the following blocked hours

options_per_site_pause_max_size.message: Max number of "Pause Blocking Per Rule" context menu items

options_incognito.message: Options page is not available on the incognito context

options_remove_all_confirm.message:
Are you sure you want to remove all existing blocking rules?

You can refresh the page without saving to restore the rules.

popup_reverse_hint.message: Blocked by default in reverse mode. Open the site and use "Add to Whitelist" to allow it.

blocked_rule_ph.message: Blocking rule (edit to change the scope)

blocked_note_ph.message: Add a note for this site…

blocked_master_password.message: Enter the master password, then press enter to unblock

blocked_unlock_duration.message: Choose how long to unlock this site

blocked_unlock_tab.message: While tabs of this site are open

blocked_paste.message: Paste is not accepted. Type the password instead.

blocked_context.message: Access to context menu is forbidden.

blocked_drop.message: Drop is not accepted. Type the password instead.

options_tab_blocking_rules_desc.message: Manage the hostnames and patterns that are blocked.

options_tab_schedule_desc.message: Choose when blocking runs and when it pauses.

options_tab_behavior_desc.message: Control startup blocking, context-menu actions, pauses, and notifications.

options_tab_unlocking_desc.message: Choose how long and how easily blocked sites can be accessed.

options_tab_blocked_page_desc.message: Customize the page shown when a site is blocked.

options_tab_tools_desc.message: Back up or restore preferences, preview blocking, and get support.

options_schedule_intro.message: A Block entry blocks the selected hours. An Allow entry pauses blocking. Days without an entry stay blocked all day.

options_schedule_note_block.message: On $1: blocking is active $2–$3; sites are unblocked outside this window.

options_schedule_note_allow.message: On $1: blocking is paused all day.

options_schedule_note_all_block.message: Every day is covered. Blocking is active $1–$2; sites are unblocked outside this window.

options_schedule_note_all_allow.message: Every day is covered. Blocking is paused all day.

options_schedule_note_unselected.message: Not covered by this entry: $1. Those days stay blocked all day unless another entry covers them.

options_schedule_note_no_times.message: Select a start and end time to see the effect on those days.

options_schedule_note_rule.message: This entry applies only to sites matching the rule.

options_schedule_intro_reverse.message: Reverse mode blocks everything except allowed sites. A schedule entry allows matching sites during the selected periods. Days without an entry stay blocked by default.

options_schedule_empty_reverse.message: No schedule entries. Reverse mode blocks everything except allowed sites.

options_schedule_note_allow_window_all.message: Every day is covered. Sites are allowed $1–$2.

options_schedule_note_allow_day.message: On $1: sites are allowed all day.

options_schedule_note_allow_day_all.message: Every day is covered. Sites are allowed all day.

options_schedule_note_unselected_reverse.message: Not covered by this entry: $1. Those days stay blocked by default in reverse mode.

options_schedule_note_rule_reverse.message: Only sites matching the rule are allowed during this entry.
